name: match-score-card
title: Match score card
description: A fixture or result: two teams, the score, the state (live, full time or kickoff time) and the competition, read as one sentence.
docs: home and away are { name, logo?, score? } and status is scheduled, live or finished. A live match shows 'Live' beside a pulsing dot that holds still under reduced motion, with the minute written 'N min' (a number, or text such as '45+2'); a finished one shows 'Full time' and, when kickoff is given, its date; a scheduled one shows the kickoff time and date, or 'TBC' without one. kickoff is an exact moment (a Date, a timestamp or an ISO string with its offset) written in timeZone and locale, so the server and the browser agree. Scores are tabular, and the winner of a finished match is set in heavier type and said in words ('Halcyon FC won', or 'Draw'). The card is read as one sentence and its drawing is hidden from assistive technology: 'Halcyon FC 2, Kestrel United 1, full time', 'Halcyon FC 2, Kestrel United 1, live, 67 minutes' or 'Halcyon FC versus Kestrel United, Sunday 9 November, 14:30'. With href the whole card is the link. A missing crest becomes the team's initials, and long names are cut with an ellipsis and carry the full name as their title. The score column grows for a score of three digits, and the scores keep one right edge. labels carries every word.
